note: Piece 1 of Quickstep: the feet before the name; the bay nobody could sit; the father's silence as consent. Kept off: a name for the father, the holding or the boys; the grey mare is only the long grey mare in the far field (piece 2 names the filly out of her for the thistles).
next_must_know: The grey mare in the far field is the one he rides off the hill to the muster in piece 2; she is the dam of the grey he will name, unnamed on the page; the bay is his father's and stays on the hill. He knows as a boy that the lances buy greys and never bays.

threads.note: Tale 1 p1: the long grey mare in the far field, unnamed; piece 2 names the filly out of her for the thistles.
